title: Higher Than Normal Call Volumes (Normal Never Comes)
style: liquid drum and bass, 174 bpm, rolling sub bass, atmospheric pads, deadpan female corporate voiceover sample, frustrated build, telephone-line ringing percussion, comedic but cathartic, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the sub, late-night call-centre rave
lyrics:
[Intro — corporate voiceover]
(robotic female) Due to higher than normal call volumes…
Your wait time is… longer than usual…
We apologise for the inconvenience…

[Verse 1]
It's been higher than normal since two thousand and four
When does normal show up, can someone open the door
Every single time I call, the volume is higher than the last
The baseline keeps moving, the present is always the past

[Pre-Drop]
If this is higher than normal, what is normal anyway
Does normal exist or is it just something they say

[Drop]
Higher — higher — higher than normal call volumes
Normal — normal — normal never comes
Higher — higher — the wait time only grows
Three-three-six on the line, where normal goes nobody knows

[Verse 2]
I've outlived three iPhones on this hold
My children grew up, the receipt got old
The muzak looped a thousand times today
The robot still apologises the very same way

[Drop]
Higher — higher — higher than normal call volumes
Normal — normal — normal never comes
Higher — higher — the wait time only grows
Three-three-six on the line, where normal goes nobody knows

[Outro — voiceover fades into bassline]
(robotic) Thank you for your continued patience…
Thank you… thank you… thank you…
